title: hub S4: policy module (single authorization point)
description: Pure hub/policy.rs + hub/components.rs: authorize_commit/authorize_proposal (proposals -> MembershipActions, self vs other, external joiner as actor, by-ref already authorized), commit-level rules (removed/banned users' clients all removed; added clients' users in new list; roles/preauth changes not mixed with participant changes; credential identity changes refused; GCE/PSK refused, §8.6 via P1 per H2; removed/banned committers only Remove/SelfRemove; check_constraints after commit .3.24; H21), authorize_send, authorize_group_info (H13), Occupancy, components apply per .5.48/.3.20. Oracle spec-derived tables + Appendix A. Tests: wrong identity rejected for every action/arm; banned user's commit refused; .3.50 non-enforcement documented. See the .6 design field (approved plan) and decisions .6.1-.6.21.
